notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes 1.1.1[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Killed “THE NUMBERS” bug… for the third time.
[*] Mouse cursor is now locked to the game application in windowed mode when not in the pause menu.
[/list]
[h2]Tangia Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a max enemy count to prevent viewers from crashing the game.
[*] Interactions are now paused when the player is interacting with a chest or NPC.
[*] "Pack of Enemies" reduced from 5 to 3 to make interactions more fair to the streamer.
[*] Enemies spawned through Tangia now have adaptive attack stats to prevent the streamer being insta-killed by high level enemies early in their run.
[*] Viewer’s username now appears over enemies they have spawned.
[*] Fixed an issue where "Camera Flip" would not return to normal after the set duration.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes 0.0.2[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a CRITICAL issue where Lady Tangle’s death animation wouldn’t finish playing which prevented the Ascendant Cap from spawning.
[*] Fixed a CRITICAL issue where Slimes would sometimes not be collected by the Soul Chest causing the room to stay locked.
[*] Fixed an issue where Spore Spreaders could knock players into corners that would trap them in place.
[*] Fixed an issue where restarting the tutorial wouldn’t activate the intro sequence.
[*] Fixed an issue where items combined by the Meizer when the players inventory was full caused the item to disappear.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decreased the maximum enemy spawn in the Hungering Goliath boss fight from 7 -> 4 to encourage more focus on the boss and decrease being overwhelmed by enemies.

Notes: Player feedback suggested this boss fight felt more like an endless fighting room and less like a boss fight. This change should remedy that frustration and return focus to the boss.

[*] Decreased health for the Enchanted Armor and Phantom Minibosses to reduce the “bullet sponge” feel.

Notes: Player feedback suggested these fights were feeling more “tedious” than challenging. Future updates may have to increase boss difficulty to offset the reduced health pools.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo 0.4 Has Arrived!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've been watching your playthroughs of the Ascendant demo and are so appreciative of your overwhelming support! As expected some bugs have cropped up, luckily we were able to cast them into the shadow realm with this update.

[list]
[*] Fixed game breaking bug that prevented players from being able to complete rooms when an enchanted armor failed to detach.
[*] Fixed bug that broke the starter wand cap if combined with the "Brittlebones" cap.
[*] Music has been added to the main menu and tutorial.
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy the demo as we work hard to get the full release finished! Please reach out to support@imagisphere.com if you encounter any more bugs.

Follow us on X @imagisphereinc for frequent updates!

Fixed bug that broke the starter wand cap if combined with the "Brittlebones" cap.
